items.title: Why Jack Henry (JKHY) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of financial technology provider Jack Henry & Associates (NASDAQ:JKHY) jumped 2.6% in the afternoon session after KeyBanc analyst Andrew Schmidt initiated coverage on the company with an Overweight rating, reported by Streetinsider. An Overweight rating indicates that the analyst expects the stock to outperform the average total return of benchmark or sector peers over the coverage horizon.
